subtitle: Lesson 30 · Capstone: A Real Multi-Environment Terraform Project

caption: The backend key is a literal string -- it can't reference a variable or function -- and it's the one line that differs.

code:
# envs/dev/dev.tfvars
environment        = "dev"
vnet_address_space = ["10.10.0.0/20"]
subnet_count       = 2

# envs/prod/prod.tfvars
environment        = "prod"
vnet_address_space = ["10.20.0.0/16"]
subnet_count       = 6
caption: Same default subnet_newbits = 8 on a smaller vs. larger parent block yields small vs. large subnets automatically.

code:
cd envs/dev
terraform init
terraform plan  -var-file="dev.tfvars"
terraform apply -var-file="dev.tfvars"

cd ../prod
terraform init
terraform plan  -var-file="prod.tfvars"
terraform apply -var-file="prod.tfvars"
caption: Each init reads that folder's own backend -- dev and prod never read or write the same state file.
